services.name: Youth Fishing & Boating Club
services.desc: Class Sessions with Parents Invited 2.5 Hours About Whether we’re fishing or exploring the Hudson, Join our October pop-up club and spend the afternoon fishing, learning, and exploring the Hudson with Hoboken Boat Charters. Fall is the perfect time to learn about the Hudson River ecosystem. The waters are full of striped bass, bluefish, sand sharks, and other species that will be certain to create memories and good times. Enjoy the afternoon on Popeye, our spectacular 42-foot powerboat with a large heated cabin and panoramic views. Our Coast Guard certified captain and first mate 2.5 Hours • All Ages • Class Sessions with Parents Invited

services.name: Sunset Cruise with a Fishing Option
services.desc: Join Us For a Sunset Cruise with a Fishing Option 3 Hours About Sit back, relax, and enjoy an instant vacation on the Hudson River. Experience breathtaking sunset views of the iconic NYC skyline from the deck of our spacious lobster boat. The Empire State Building, Statue of Liberty, Freedom Tower and Brooklyn Bridge truly dazzle as the sun sets. Come with a camera, your favorite beverage and a smile and leave with unforgettable memories. Bring your own favorite beverage and snack. And add an additional bonus of dropping a fishing line where we supply the rod and the 3 Hours • All Ages • Wednesday - Sunday Departures

blurb: Guests can enjoy boat charters including sightseeing cruises and fishing trips, join a sailing club with access to J80s and sailing lessons, or participate in water sports like jetskiing, kayaking, and paddleboarding. The marina offers modern amenities and is located minutes from NYC. Pier 13 provides food, drinks, and entertainment during the summer.
